context: Tests whether the agent refuses the skill's anti-patterns (building before the spec, a chatbot wrapper, training a model, boiling the ocean, real personal data in the demo) and answers a logistics question briefly from the event facts before steering back to coaching.

checklist.name: Build-before-spec refused
checklist.description: Message 1: the coach refuses to skip the spec and redirects to Phase 2

checklist.name: No code in response
checklist.description: Message 1's response contains no code, file structures or setup steps

checklist.name: Model training refused
checklist.description: Message 2: the coach refuses fine-tuning a model and says to build on top of Claude

checklist.name: Chatbot challenged
checklist.description: Message 2: the coach challenges the generic chatbot as the most basic use of AI and asks what it reads, extracts or does

checklist.name: Scope cut
checklist.description: Message 2: the coach rejects 'the whole French healthcare system' and asks for one user at one moment

checklist.name: Real patient data refused
checklist.description: Message 3: the coach refuses the hospital records, requires synthetic or properly anonymised data, and points to the data-protection / GDPR mentor

checklist.name: Logistics answered from the guide
checklist.description: Message 4: the coach answers correctly and briefly: final at 18:00 Saturday in the Salons scientifiques, 5-minute pitch + 5 minutes Q&A, winner represents Sciences Po in Cannes (and the cash/credit prizes)

checklist.name: Steers back
checklist.description: Message 4: after answering, the coach steers back to the hack

checklist.name: Voice maintained
checklist.description: All responses are short and direct, with no apologies for pushing back
